status: Numerical gates passed on macOS and Windows; Windows runtime target failed in short runs. Corrected long test stopped at user request because every short-run motion call already exceeded the deadline.

disposition.loading_and_cache: Suitable for independent adoption; Windows preparation improved and exact/correctness checks passed. Windows timing is a single pair per sample rate, not a stable speedup guarantee.
disposition.runtime_v3_combination: Reject as the production delivery for this target: both 32-source motion short runs missed all 1024 deadlines, with some 16-source regressions. Numerically valid is not runtime acceptance.
disposition.subband: Research only: isolated early-reflection speedup, additional latency and acoustic differences, no full-session acceptance.
disposition.invalid_avx_trial: Discard all performance and acceptance results from the numerically incorrect candidate.
disposition.workspace: Runtime v3 implementation withdrawn and archived privately; production policy restored to v2. Loading and validation tools separated for adoption. Original user research remains unstaged.

order: Necessary native correctness and numerical checks
Applicable cross-platform and long-run acceptance only after the Windows short gate passes
future_validation_policy.on_failure: Stop this candidate; do not continue macOS performance sweeps or long runs. A revised candidate starts again with Windows short screening.
future_validation_policy.independent_loading_scope: Loading gains are judged independently and do not offset runtime failures. Isolated subchain performance does not satisfy the full-session gate.

rejected_windows_trial.reason: AVX deinterleave_shfl returned shuffled lanes; writing directly into canonical planes caused a numerical failure. Corrected by restoring bin order.
